propositions: CodeReviewBatchRunner currently iterates only static req.criteria and stamps findings with reviewer_id but not logical criterion_id, causing activated project criteria to never enter Round A/B
Project criteria must execute exactly once in Round A only, not in Round B, and findings must be attributed with logical criterion_id while preserving existing tags
Active LLM-tier project criteria are resolved at batch assembly time via registry.effective_criteria and registry.effective_routing, then passed as additive project_criteria tuples to the runner
The runner branches on req.step_id to combine project entries only when step_id equals round_a, keeping round_b execution unchanged and deterministic across retries
Missing or malformed project criterion prompts raise a located LLMError naming the criterion and expected .rebar/prompts path
